world.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original production-quality background for a beautiful candy bakery slot game, cinematic wide landscape about 2:1, 2048 pixels wide if possible.
Primary request: a whimsical dimensional artisan candy bakery world, celadon mint painted cabinetry, berry-red velvet and glazed sweets, warm cream plaster, sculpted frosting architecture and brass patisserie details. Richly painted depth, sophisticated delight, tactile sugar and baked pastry. Not a flat candy gradient or copied game art.
Composition: the central-left 70 percent is calm, lower contrast deep celadon and muted cream shadow, with a broad softly lit unoccupied bakery worktop and distant cabinets, usable for a large rectangular reel board overlay. The detailed magical patisserie display is gathered on the rightmost quarter: a towering tiered cupcake stand, huge sculptural pink-iced donut, jewel-like jars of pastel sweets, hanging tiny copper baking utensils, and a warm arched bakery window. A restrained framing sweep of carved mint cabinetry runs along left edge; warm cream flour dust in the volumetric morning light. Keep background objects clear of the central-left reel region, nothing creates a baked-in board frame. Three-dimensional eye-level scene, inviting depth and artisanal details.
Style: exceptionally polished hand-painted 2.5D game concept art, painterly volumetric materials, buttercream soft peaks, glazed sugar highlights, visible baked golden crumb, smooth mint enamel and warm copper. Mint/celadon, raspberry pink, warm ivory, restrained caramel shadows. Beautiful not childish, playful without cartoon outlines. High quality illustrated world with coherent believable lighting.
Constraints: no people, no text, letters, labels, numbers, logos, watermarks, UI, reels, grid, slot machine, central arch, no emoji, no flat vector, no cheap plastic or candy-gradient backdrop. All packaging blank. Wide landscape environment only.

atlas.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original high-end candy bakery game sprite atlas on TRUE transparent alpha, landscape 4:3 canvas preferably 2048x1536. EXACTLY TWELVE separate icons in four columns and three rows of equal imaginary square cells. Each icon centered in its cell and no more than 72% of the cell's width or height. Lots of transparent space between icons; never overlap. Grid cell center positions x=12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5%; y=16.67%,50%,83.33%. Do not draw the grid.
Primary request: beautifully modeled hand-painted 2.5D artisan sweet icons, coherent celadon mint, raspberry berry, cream, caramel and restrained candy blue palette. Crisp readable silhouettes, premium confectionery textures, dimensional icing peaks and jewel-like hard sugar, appetizing painted forms, warm upper-left light. Not flat vectors or emoji. Matching a refined magical mint-and-cream patisserie world.
Exact reading order:
Row1 col1: thick golden baked ring donut with pale raspberry pink icing and a few tiny cream-and-mint sprinkles, angled three-quarter view, clear central hole.
Row1 col2: golden cupcake in scalloped celadon paper, magnificent white buttercream swirl and one glossy raspberry on top.
Row1 col3: berry pink and cream layered frozen popsicle on short wooden stick, soft beveled rectangular silhouette.
Row1 col4: golden gingerbread person with white piped icing face and mint gumdrop buttons, simple friendly symmetrical silhouette.
Row2 col1: one plump glossy red jellybean, curving kidney shape, naturally translucent sugar.
Row2 col2: one luminous blue gumball, perfectly spherical, broad painted shine and volume.
Row2 col3: one round mint-and-cream swirled peppermint disk, green spiral, no stick.
Row2 col4: raspberry pink candy in twisted shiny translucent candy wrapper, horizontal compact silhouette.
Row3 col1: blue candy in twisted shiny translucent wrapper, horizontal compact silhouette.
Row3 col2: round raspberry-pink and cream spiral lollipop on a short ivory stick with small mint bow, clearly distinct from mint disk.
Row3 col3: golden five-point sugar star cookie with pale pink icing, blank center for later native number.
Row3 col4: small ornate celadon and antique-gold candy jar filled with multicolored tiny gumdrops, decorative spare ornament, no label.
Constraints: all twelve icons fully intact. Transparent outside each object, antialiased opaque object surfaces, no outside cast shadows or glow halos. NO backdrop, floor, checkerboard, gridline, cell background, text, numbers, letters, logos or watermarks. Generous gutters essential. Distinct original production game art.
atlas.spacingEdit:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the attached ORIGINAL candy atlas; keep all twelve exact icon designs, materials, colors, their correct reading order and the true transparent background. Change ONLY positioning and scale for safe production sprite separation.
CRITICAL: each icon currently fills too much space. Make every icon 65% OF ITS CURRENT width and height, preserving aspect ratios, and center it within its own equal square cell. The new sheet should have conspicuously BIG transparent empty gaps, approximately one third of a cell between icons. Do not enlarge any icon to fill empty areas. No shadows, glows or speckles outside icons.
Canvas must remain 4:3 with exactly FOUR equal columns and THREE equal rows. Centers x=12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5% of width and y=16.6667%,50%,83.3333% of height. Every icon fully contained inside its cell with clear transparent margin on all sides.
Order row1 donut, cupcake, popsicle, gingerbread; row2 jellybean, gumball, mintdisk, pinkwrappedcandy; row3 bluewrappedcandy, lollipop, starcookie, candyjar. The candyjar top MUST have a big empty gap below the pink candy; the lollipop MUST have a big empty gap below the gumball. No cropping, all objects fully intact. Preserve original artwork style and true alpha. No drawn gridlines, checkerboard, opaque background, text, labels, numbers, or UI.
